entities.name: Enslavement of Trine
entities.description: Event in which Xarl bound the Serra Angel Trine, lasting three centuries.

entities.name: Xarl
entities.description: Spellsquire turned archmage who enslaved Trine and became the Great Father.

entities.name: Trine
entities.description: Serra Angel made a fallen angel by the Horned Halo.

entities.name: Skule
entities.description: Wizard who recruited Xarl and was forced to summon Trine.

entities.name: Horned Halo
entities.description: Item placed on Trine to bind her.

entities.name: Angel Keep
entities.description: Castle in Wolf's Hackle granted to Xarl.

entities.name: Absolution of Trine
entities.description: Event ending Xarl and Trine's rule.

entities.name: Dakkon Blackblade
entities.description: Wandered the planes looking for Dihada.

events.summary: Xarl forced Skule to summon Trine and placed the Horned Halo on her head, binding her.
events.quote: He then placed the Horned Halo on Trine's head, binding her to him and making her a fallen angel .

events.summary: Mandek Ironfist granted Xarl Angel Keep in Wolf's Hackle.
events.quote: Xarl was granted a castle in the mountains of Wolf's Hackle by Mandek Ironfist.

events.summary: Xarl made Trine forget her past and became the most powerful man in Corondor.
events.quote: he magically caused Trine to forget her past as an angel of Serra.

relations.quote: he eventually came into the service of the barbarian Warlord Mandek Ironfist
forced his former mentor Skule to summon the Serra Angel Trine
